gbr_the_hay_wain.webp.note: Recognisable reworking of The Hay Wain; composition altered (square crop, added horses, woman, fence) but same subject and palette.

fra_arrangement_in_grey_and_black_no_1.w.note: Recognisable reproduction of Whistler's Mother; curtain moved to the right and recoloured, but the composition and palette are broadly consistent.

nld_wheatfield_with_crows.webp.note: Sky is noticeably darker than the original, but the overall palette and composition match.

prt_porto_s_o_bento_azulejo_panels.webp.note: Image 1 is a photo of the São Bento station building, not the azulejo panels. Image 2 shows stone molding, floor and wall around the tiles.

ita_the_last_supper.webp.note: Image 2 extends beyond the painting: it adds an arched lunette ceiling with coats of arms and a tiled floor around the artwork.

gbr_sunflowers.webp.note: Background is yellow instead of pale blue-green, the vase lacks the 'Vincent' signature, and the flower arrangement is different, so it reads as a new composition.

gbr_happy_accident_on_the_swing.webp.note: Palette shifted from dark blue-green and teal to golden-olive; composition is mirrored and rearranged, but the work is still recognisable.

esp_the_nude_maja.webp.note: Image 2 shows a clothed woman in a sheer white gown, mirrored pose with arms behind head; resembles The Clothed Maja, not the Nude Maja.

can_massacre_of_the_innocents.webp.note: Image 2 is a new composition: different layout, church placement and figures. Its sky is grey rather than pale blue, and the palette is muted.

fra_self_portrait.webp.note: Image 2 shows a different painting: an elderly man in a beret, facing forward. The original is a young man with his face half in shadow.

fra_the_bridge_at_narni.webp.note: Composition differs: the original has a wide river valley and a multi-arch bridge with one tall arch on the right. This version shows a hilltop town, a gorge and a donkey.

usa_dogs_playing_poker.webp.note: Image 2 is a dark, new composition of dogs at a round table, not the train-car scene; its palette is much darker and moodier.

usa_saint_george_and_the_dragon.webp.note: Image 2 reverses the composition and shows a dark night sky with a spiral and hills, unlike the original's teal sky and crescent moon.

usa_breezing_up.webp.note: Image 2 shows three figures in a different boat with no 'GLOUCESTER' lettering, and a different composition; it is a reinterpretation, not Breezing Up.

gbr_the_ladies_waldegrave.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the poses, table, and objects differ from the original, and the sitters are rearranged. It's a loose reinterpretation, not the same painting.

fra_et_in_arcadia_ego.webp.note: Image 2 is a new composition: different poses, figures, clothing, stone tomb and mountain landscape. It is not Guercino's painting, though the theme is the same.

usa_watson_and_the_shark.webp.note: Recognisable recreation of Watson and the Shark; poses, clothing and harbour differ, but composition, subject and colours are similar.

usa_the_avenue_in_the_rain.webp.note: Image 2 is a new composition: symmetrical street with horse carriages and Gothic spires, not Hassam's tall, close-up flags and umbrellas.

fra_patrocles.webp.note: Original is a single nude man seen from behind on red cloth; reproduction shows a mourning scene with many armored soldiers around a corpse.

fra_napoleon_crossing_the_alps.webp.note: Horse changed from white/grey to chestnut brown and cape from red to mustard yellow; overall palette noticeably darker and different.

usa_the_musicians.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the poses, the grapes held aloft, the horn, and the open songbook all differ from Caravaggio's original, so it is not recognisable as the same painting.

usa_the_gross_clinic.webp.note: Recognisable recreation of The Gross Clinic; composition and palette match, with minor differences in details, signature and cropping.

fra_water_lilies.webp.note: Composition differs: different lily pad arrangement and two blossoms; appears to be another Monet Water Lilies painting, not the same work.

usa_the_peaceable_kingdom.webp.note: Reproduction is a new composition: different layout, no Penn treaty ship or text borders, animals and child rearranged, landscape changed. Not Edward Hicks's work.

usa_pollice_verso.webp.note: Different composition: no pointing crowd, no draped carpets, no fallen second gladiator, and the viewpoint differs. It reads as a new painting, not Pollice Verso.

fra_the_embarkation_to_cythera.webp.note: Image 2 is a reimagined composition: couples, bust, boat and cherubs are rearranged and the landscape differs, so it is not recognisably Watteau's original.

gbr_the_laughing_cavalier.webp.note: Image 2 is a new composition: different costume, lace collar, hand-on-hip pose and no inscription, so it is not recognisable as The Laughing Cavalier.

deu_the_fox.webp.note: Image 2 shows a single curled sleeping fox with blue/purple geometric background, not the original's two interlocked foxes in red-green fragmented composition.

usa_the_grand_canal_venice.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: Santa Maria della Salute dome at center, Gothic palace at left, orange sail at right, unlike Turner's original.

gbr_a_boat_passing_a_lock.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: sunny blue sky, bridge, cottage, towing horse, calm water. The original has a stormy dark sky, lock gates, a lock-keeper and a dog.

mlt_the_beheading_of_saint_john_the_bapt.note: Composition differs: no arch, figures rearranged, the executioner's pose and the setting are changed. It reads as a loose reinterpretation, not Caravaggio's painting.

rus_perseus_and_andromeda.webp.note: Recomposed scene: Andromeda clothed beside a rock, open stormy sea setting, white horse instead of piebald Pegasus, no Medusa shield, no cave or dragon.

ita_deposition_from_the_cross.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: figures, poses and layout differ from Rosso Fiorentino's Deposition, with a hill setting and no arched format.

rus_blue_dancers.webp.note: Image 2 shows a different Degas composition, 'Dancers in Blue', with four dancers and flowers in their hair, not the original 'Blue Dancers'.

fra_grande_odalisque.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the pose, peacock fan, drapery and setting are reworked, so it is not recognisably Ingres' Grande Odalisque.

fra_the_thinker.webp.note: Image 2 shows a garden with hedges, a wall, gravel path and urn behind the sculpture, not a plain museum background.

ita_ecstasy_of_saint_teresa.webp.note: Image 2 shows the surrounding chapel architecture: dark marble columns, pediment, and wall panels beyond the sculpture group and gilded rays.

usa_composition_viii.webp.note: Image 2 is a loose reinterpretation; the composition, shapes and layout differ substantially from Kandinsky's Composition VIII, so it would not be recognised as the original.
